issues.issue: An unexplained Miscellaneous line is 30% of governmental revenue and more than 11 times its budget. Nothing in the trimmed pages says what it is (it could be insurance proceeds, a reimbursement or a one-time receipt). It stays 'other' as printed, but a person may want to check the full report's notes.

The Street fund's intergovernmental revenue is probably mostly highway allocation (Statement of Activities: Public Works operating grants 151,782), but no breakdown is printed. other state aid is defensible.
